Description: Measures the average price of the products that have the highest quantity of sales.
Formula: SUM (Sales Amount) / Quantity Sold), then calculate top 5 or 10, by Product, State, Month, Segment.

Description: Tracks the change in sales over a specific period of time for each state.
Formula: (Sales Amount of Current Period - Sales Amount of Previous Period) / Sales Amount of Previous Period

Description: Identifies the customers who have made the highest total purchases in each consumer segment or given the most profit.
Formula: Sum (Sales Amount) by Customer by Segment

KPI: Top/Bottom Products According to Sales by State
Description: Identifies the products with the highest and lowest sales in each state.
Formula: Sum (Sales Amount) by Product by State

KPI: Top/Bottom Products According to Average Delivery Time by State
Description: Identifies the products with the fastest and slowest average delivery times in each state.
Formula: Average (Ship Date - Order Date) by Product by State
